results.question: (a) Does Obergefell apply in ASM today; what happened since 2015 'still reviewing'?
results.fact: ASM performs no same-sex marriages. The 2022 federal Respect for Marriage Act forces recognition of unions performed elsewhere.

evidence.title: Same-sex marriage in American Samoa - Wikipedia

results.question: (b) Sodomy-law status and decriminalisation date
results.fact: First sodomy law 1963; Fono removed it in the 1979 criminal-code revision, effective 1980. Age of consent equal at 16 regardless of gender/orientation.

evidence.title: LGBTQ rights in American Samoa - Wikipedia

results.question: (c) Gender-identity/document regime (birth certificate), 2024-26 changes
results.fact: Birth-certificate edits limited to record errors; gender marker may change only with medical documentation; no local discrimination protections.

evidence.title: LGBTQ rights in American Samoa - Wikipedia

results.question: (d) Any 2024-26 ruling, law, or documented incident involving trans people in ASM
results.fact: No new law/ruling/incident located; 2026 law-review article (ASM Legal Aid/FFRF) argues Obergefell must apply; marriage licences still withheld on-island.

evidence.title: Same-sex marriage in American Samoa (cites July 2024 Samoa News on-island survey; 2026 law review)

results.fact: Federal passport policy reaches ASM nationals, but no ASM-specific dated source retrieved; left unverified rather than asserted.
